nodes.label: Bounded, read-only Airbnb extraction. No login or paid service required.
nodes.norm_label: bounded, read-only airbnb extraction. no login or paid service required.

nodes.label: Azul search over HTTP/1.1, keeping one anonymous session throughout.
nodes.norm_label: azul search over http/1.1, keeping one anonymous session throughout.

nodes.label: Fase 10 — Route planner and geolocation
nodes.rationale: Up to 8 planner stops per city, persisted; multi-point OSRM walking preview with numbered badges; my_location with an accuracy circle and a warning beyond 80 km; planner stops enter hotel ranking priorities with weight +6.

nodes.label: Trip leg precedence (src/trip/legs.ts)
nodes.rationale: Replaces the hardcoded walk mode that turns Orly → Noisy into a ~20 km walk on public OSRM: 1) the authored catalog leg for the from→to pair, 2) the via: mode (walk uses OSRM, other modes a dashed neutral straight line), 3) walk only when haversine ≤ 1.5 km, otherwise a straight line without OSRM.

nodes.label: transferRow(leg) transfer line (src/views/transfer-row.ts)
nodes.rationale: Mode icon (walk, transit, taxi, flight), label, duration and a chip in the line color between stops; built once for the trip document and reused by the Fase 8 city timeline.

nodes.label: Fase 6 — Places list and panel v2
nodes.norm_label: fase 6 — places list and panel v2
nodes.rationale: Category <details> groups with live-count chips, subgrid place rows (thumbnail, favorite, subcategory, rating, price) with a ~350 ms hover preview, StarRating and PriceLevel ports, a non-modal dialog panel with a bleeding photo slider and lazy Overpass 'open now', and a richer searchBlob.

nodes.label: Fase 8 — City itinerary timeline
nodes.rationale: Day headers with stop counts and split food vs ticket budget chips (computeTripBudget is exported but never used), morning/afternoon/evening periods from ItinerarySlot, one transfer row per transit hop, ORY/CDG arrival tabs, numbered day-layer pins with the rest at 0.22 opacity, and synced leg hover between list and map.

nodes.label: Fase 12 — Catalog pipeline port (Notion sync, OSM areas, photos, stay display)
nodes.norm_label: fase 12 — catalog pipeline port (notion sync, osm areas, photos, stay display)
nodes.rationale: The user chose to port the portfolio's catalog pipeline (travel:notion:*, travel:areas*, travel:photos:check, build-stay-display). One writer only: after the port the portfolio should stop pushing to Notion, but removing that requires the user's explicit OK.

nodes.label: City section (## City + city: slug + dates:)
nodes.norm_label: city section (## city + city: slug + dates:)
nodes.rationale: One H2 per city in travel order; the next non-empty line is city: <slug> using a catalog slug (paris, milao, roma, lisboa, porto, sao-paulo, florianopolis, new-york, miami), optionally followed by dates: YYYY-MM-DD → YYYY-MM-DD.

nodes.label: Day section (### Dia N — Title)
nodes.rationale: One H3 per day, in order, inside its city.

nodes.label: Trip export (Apple Notes HTML, Notion Markdown, .md download)
nodes.norm_label: trip export (apple notes html, notion markdown, .md download)
nodes.rationale: Export rewrites the same document: headings, bullets, bold and italic stay; place:<id> becomes a Google Maps link; the city: line is dropped and dates: becomes one line under the city heading. The clipboard gets text/html for Apple Notes and text/plain Markdown for Notion.

nodes.label: Multi-city trip (several H2 sections = one trip)
nodes.norm_label: multi-city trip (several h2 sections = one trip)
nodes.rationale: The UI shows a city rail and one scrolling document; the map fits every resolved stop.

nodes.label: Narrative paragraphs under a day
nodes.rationale: Free text with **bold**, *italic* and extra lists renders and exports but never becomes a stop or a pin.

nodes.label: Stop bullet (HH:mm + link + — note)
nodes.rationale: A stop is a bullet with an optional HH:mm, then a link (catalog [Label](place:<placeId>) or external [Label](https://...)), then an optional note after an em dash.

nodes.label: Trip artifact format travel-boss/trip/v1
nodes.rationale: One Markdown file per trip at content/trips/<id>.md, parsed and rendered by the UI and live-updated by npm run dev on save. No HTML comments, YAML front matter or raw HTML. A trip file only references place ids: coordinates, ratings and hotel ranking stay in src/data, and hotel/Airbnb search stays on /api/hotel-search.

nodes.label: Europa · Milão leg (2026-04-06 → 04-09)
nodes.rationale: Day 2 is a same-day train trip from Joy 124 via Milano Centrale; the destination itinerary (Verona or Venice) is meant to become another city block in this file.

nodes.label: Europa · Paris leg (2026-04-02 → 04-06)
nodes.rationale: Light arrival afternoon near the Eiffel Tower (Orly, Metro 14, Auchan Noisy, Casa do Gui); the full Orly or CDG arrival day stays in the city catalog, not in this file.

nodes.label: Piazza Venezia stop listed after the narrative paragraph
nodes.norm_label: piazza venezia stop listed after the narrative paragraph
nodes.rationale: The last Roma Dia 1 bullet sits below the narrative paragraph; plan task 2.16 moves it up into the stop list.

nodes.label: Europa · Roma leg (2026-04-09 → 04-13)
nodes.rationale: One walking day in the ancient centre (Colosseum, Forum, Pantheon, Trevi); the other Rome places stay in the city catalog.

nodes.label: Design tokens (tokens.css: color, type, control heights, z-layers)
nodes.norm_label: design tokens (tokens.css: color, type, control heights, z-layers)
nodes.rationale: Only tokens for color, space, type, radius, motion and z-index, never loose values. --color-mid-gray #666666 fixes the 4.35:1 AA failure of #737373 on #f5f5f5; z-layers (map 0 to toast 50) plus isolation on .tb-map keep Leaflet's z 400/1000 under the panel; the chrome stays achromatic, with category color only on pins and glyphs. Task 1.7 gives every control hover, active, focus-visible, disabled and selected states.

nodes.label: End-to-end verification checklist
nodes.rationale: Per phase at 1440×900 and 1280×800: live artifact (<1 s update keeping days, focus and scroll, idle Network tab), export pasted into Apple Notes and Notion, identical .tb-row__actions left, places, itinerary, hotels, reduced motion, keyboard, contrast ≥ 4.5:1 and concentric radius pairs.

nodes.label: Fase 13 — Performance (lazy data, polite OSRM, measure first)
nodes.norm_label: fase 13 — performance (lazy data, polite osrm, measure first)
nodes.rationale: Baseline 2026-09-23: production JS is 1.84 MB (518 KB gzip). travel-areas-osm.ts (4.8k lines) and the heatmap load via import(); OSRM walking routes get a ~300-entry localStorage LRU, are requested only for open days or the visible city, with at most 2 concurrent requests to the public FOSSGIS server; partial repaint only if paint() exceeds 16 ms.

nodes.label: Fase 14 — Dark theme (last, by user request)
nodes.norm_label: fase 14 — dark theme (last, by user request)
nodes.rationale: Deferred to the end by the user; once 1.3 and 11.5 leave no off-token color, dark tokens come via :root[data-theme=dark] + prefers-color-scheme, the basemap re-tints live without remounting, and an icon-only toggle persisted in tb:theme syncs color-scheme and theme-color.

nodes.label: Fase 5 — Multi-city trip UI (summary strip, overview map, rail navigation)
nodes.norm_label: fase 5 — multi-city trip ui (summary strip, overview map, rail navigation)
nodes.rationale: New feature from the original request: a trip summary ('Paris → Milão → Roma · 11 noites · 2–13 abr') with a city strip proportional to nights; map.setOverview draws numbered city nodes with dashed great-circle connectors as the initial state; the rail turns from a filter into navigation with an IntersectionObserver scroll-spy that never moves the camera; city headers open hotels prefilled with the trip dates.

nodes.label: Fase 9 — Hotéis e onde ficar
nodes.rationale: Dimmed place pins on the Hotels tab, a dashed radius ring resized in place, a hotel card with score ring, sub-scores and a neighbourhood safety alert below 70, a 'why this position' disclosure, walking distances to saved places, a lazily imported stay heatmap (respecting the catalog/index.ts warning), and default dates from the trip or today+30.

nodes.label: Inline Markdown renderer (src/trip/inline.ts shared with export)
nodes.norm_label: inline markdown renderer (src/trip/inline.ts shared with export)
nodes.rationale: SCHEMA promises bold, italic and extra lists, but the UI shows raw asterisks through textContent and a bullet without a link is a parse error. Build DOM nodes (never innerHTML) for **b**, *i*, https links and place: links, which select the place in-app; link-less bullets become list notes.

nodes.label: Live save sync (state survives save, change flash, push instead of polling)
nodes.norm_label: live save sync (state survives save, change flash, push instead of polling)
nodes.rationale: Each save rebuilds the whole DOM, reopens only day 1, loses focus and selection and refits the map, while /api/trips is polled every 800 ms on top of HMR. The plan keeps open days, current stop, focus and scroll, diffs Trips to flash changed rows (.is-changed ~1.2 s), and replaces polling with a tb:trip { id } event plus GET /api/trips/:id; this is what makes live LLM edits visible.

nodes.label: Motion system (easing/duration tokens, reduced motion, unified camera)
nodes.norm_label: motion system (easing/duration tokens, reduced motion, unified camera)
nodes.rationale: Animate only opacity, transform and colors, never width/height/top/left/margin or transition: all; exits use --ease-in at ~70% of the entry duration and every --dur-* becomes 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion. The camera is 0.45 s animated or instant, fixing the animated panTo cancelled by setView. Fase 11 adds @starting-style entry/exit, animated <details> (Safari support unverified), view transitions and the sidebar slide.

nodes.label: Parser warnings badge with 'Copiar para o LLM'
nodes.norm_label: parser warnings badge with 'copiar para o llm'
nodes.rationale: Parser warnings, today a loose line, become an 'N avisos' header badge whose popover lists line: message and copies content/trips/<id>.md:<line> — <message> so the LLM can fix the file.

nodes.label: vinicius-ramos-portfolio (P, Astro origin of the travel tool)
nodes.norm_label: vinicius-ramos-portfolio (p, astro origin of the travel tool)
nodes.rationale: travel-boss (Vite + vanilla TS) came from migrating the portfolio's Astro travel tool: src/data was copied intact and is identical, but the UI was rewritten (~3.7k vs ~11.5k lines), so many features became dead data. Porting means adapting SSR behaviour to plain DOM; mobile/responsive layouts, showcase effects (magnetic pins and cursor, zoom intro), the tile service worker and the city index stay out of scope.

nodes.label: Subgrid list row primitive (src/ui/row.ts, .tb-list/.tb-row)
nodes.rationale: Rows share the list's grid tracks through subgrid, so actions sit at the same X whatever the content width. Actions hide by opacity, never display, so Tab still reaches them; onSelect makes the main area a <button>, fixing trip stops that only respond to the mouse. First consumer: trip document stops; later places (6.2), city timeline (Fase 8) and hotels (9.2).

nodes.label: via: transport annotation (stop legs 4.6a, inter-city 5.4)
nodes.rationale: An indented '- via: metrô M14 + RER E · 35 min' under the departing stop describes the leg to the next stop, and a via: line after dates: tells how you arrive from the previous city. Mode comes from PT/EN keywords and duration from (\d+)\s?(min|h); parser, SCHEMA, tripToMarkdown and tripToHtml (nested <ul>) change together, with tests.

nodes.label: Travel catalog (cities, places, city itineraries, search engine)
nodes.norm_label: travel catalog (cities, places, city itineraries, search engine)
nodes.rationale: Ported from the portfolio into src/data and scripts/; the UI imports the catalog only through src/catalog/index.ts.

nodes.label: Travel Boss (local trip-planning tool)
nodes.rationale: The on-screen document is a Markdown file in content/trips/ that an LLM edits; with npm run dev open, the screen follows every save.

nodes.label: Markdown as single source of truth (LLM edits, UI follows)
nodes.norm_label: markdown as single source of truth (llm edits, ui follows)
nodes.rationale: The trip file is the source of truth and an LLM edits the Markdown directly; never keep a second copy of the itinerary in TypeScript.

nodes.label: Architecture rules (source of truth, catalog facade, no data edits)
nodes.norm_label: architecture rules (source of truth, catalog facade, no data edits)
nodes.rationale: content/trips/*.md is the itinerary source of truth: a format change updates SCHEMA.md, parser, export and tests in the same task. The UI imports the catalog only via src/catalog/index.ts; src/data and npm dependencies are off-limits unless a task says otherwise; 🤔 marks unverified assumptions.

nodes.label: Concentric radius rule (Apple ConcentricRectangle)
nodes.rationale: Inner radius = outer radius − inset, floored at --r-min 4px like .concentric(minimum:). CSS has no stable inherit() for custom properties, so each pair is an explicit calc() token (--r-card/--inset-card, --r-row, --r-popover, --r-group). Focus rings use outline + outline-offset so they curve concentrically; rounded scroll containers scroll an inner child.

nodes.label: Executor contract (per-task workflow)
nodes.rationale: Each task: graphify query and read the task files plus the portfolio source first; stay in scope and split diffs over ~250 lines; then tsc --noEmit && npm test, a browser check at 1440×900, graphify update and a feat/fix commit. Non-trivial logic gets a small test in the parse.test.ts style. Phase 0 sets up git, the graphify graph and AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, where each new primitive adds its rule.

nodes.label: Hover reveals secondary info (+ :focus-within, always visible on hover:none)
nodes.norm_label: hover reveals secondary info (+ :focus-within, always visible on hover:none)
nodes.rationale: Secondary information appears on hover and :focus-within and stays visible on touch devices; never hide essential information or the only path to an action, and hover never moves the map camera. Task 11.6 inventories every hover surface (rows, day and city headers, chips, rating, photos, file path, warnings badge, hotel card).

nodes.label: Fase 7 — Map (glyph pins, list↔map hover, camera policy, areas, transit, controls)
nodes.norm_label: fase 7 — map (glyph pins, list↔map hover, camera policy, areas, transit, controls)
nodes.rationale: Pins get category glyphs and scale via one --pin-scale transform instead of animating width/height on 127 pins; fit ignores outliers (median + p75 radius, airports excluded) and honours TravelCity.zoom; areas fade in an SVG pane despite preferCanvas; an icon-only control stack replaces Leaflet's zoomControl while OSM attribution stays visible.

nodes.label: Map API: hover(id) vs select(id), onHover, setPadding, diffed setPins
nodes.norm_label: map api: hover(id) vs select(id), onhover, setpadding, diffed setpins
nodes.rationale: Today highlight() pans the camera. hover highlights without moving, select applies the camera policy minus the panel width, and setPins diffs by id instead of clearLayers + recreate, avoiding flicker with 127 Paris pins.

nodes.label: place:<placeId> catalog link
nodes.rationale: The id must already exist on that city; export turns it into the catalog's Google Maps https link.

nodes.label: Material Symbols Rounded icon system (src/ui/icons.ts: ICONS, icon())
nodes.norm_label: material symbols rounded icon system (src/ui/icons.ts: icons, icon())
nodes.rationale: The catalog already ships categoryMaterialIcon, placePinIconHtml and MAPS_MATERIAL_ICON, but the UI uses none of them and never loads the font. One sorted ICONS list drives the Google Fonts icon_names subset (display=block avoids flashing ligature names) and is injected by a vite.config.ts transformIndexHtml hook, so the module must not touch document at top level. Subset weight with all axes is unverified.

nodes.label: Tooltip + iconButton/iconLink controls (src/ui/tooltip.ts, controls.ts)
nodes.rationale: One fixed tooltip delegated on [data-tip]: 350 ms delay, instant 'warm' mode within 300 ms, aria-hidden because the name comes from aria-label; built in JS rather than ::after because .tb-main and the map clip overflow. Icon-only buttons are reserved for repeated row actions, map/panel controls and universal conventions; a screen's single primary action keeps its label.

nodes.label: pyairbnb pinned to git commit 1ee4151
nodes.rationale: Pinned to a GitHub commit because PyPI 2.2.0 lacks the bounded HTTP timeout support the Airbnb search script relies on.

nodes.label: Hotel search environment (airbnb-venv, Fase 0.4)
nodes.rationale: npm run travel:airbnb:setup creates node_modules/.cache/airbnb-venv, used by both the Azul HTTP/1.1 helper and Airbnb; without it Azul fails and Airbnb is disabled, and rm -rf node_modules deletes it. Executors never copy the TYPESAFE_API_KEY secret. Done when /api/hotel-search/status reports airbnb: true.

nodes.label: /api/hotel-search dev endpoint (Azul + Booking + Airbnb)
nodes.rationale: Hotel and Airbnb search exist only on the Vite dev server; Airbnb needs a one-time npm run travel:airbnb:setup.

nodes.label: TYPESAFE_API_KEY (hotel ranking key)
nodes.rationale: Optional; read from .env, and the server also falls back to the sibling portfolio's .env.

nodes.label: Shared el() DOM helper (src/ui/dom.ts, task 1.1)
nodes.rationale: Replaces three identical el() copies in shell.ts, places.ts and hotels.ts with one import.

nodes.label: Fase 2 — Confirmed audit bug fixes (2.1–2.16)
nodes.rationale: Audit bugs: locale change ignored by the trip render early-exit, photo arrows moving the map, closing the panel keeping selection, optional stops entering the route, dead CSS and code, hotel status and a11y gaps, focus lost on re-render, refit on every search keystroke, innerHTML with error.message, scroll leaks, divider clamp and ARIA, 127 pins as tab stops, export feedback toast, and the misplaced Piazza Venezia stop.

nodes.label: Fase 3 — Navigation, state and locale (hash router, store, i18n, keyboard)
nodes.norm_label: fase 3 — navigation, state and locale (hash router, store, i18n, keyboard)
nodes.rationale: Hash routes #/trip/<id> and #/city/<slug>/<tab> replace the hardcoded europa auto-open so reload and back/forward keep context; src/app/store.ts persists filters, open groups and arrival with a tb: prefix; parser errors gain code + detail so the UI localizes messages; city tabs become a real tablist with roving tabindex.
